_doc: Army composition. phases: the first whose `until` (match seconds, null = rest of the game) is not over yet applies. roles = weights of the next mech's role; maxMechOre / maxMechEnergy = cost limit of one mech's parts. roleClasses = weapon classes (stats.json weapon.class) that make an arm fit a role; a role without a fitting arm available falls back to `fallbackRole`. stance / behaviour = what the AI sets on a new mech of that role. score = weights of the loadout score (src/ai/managers/Production.js). counters (AI v2, used with difficulty.counter > 0): once at least minSeen enemy combat units were seen (Perception keeps them AI.compositionSeconds), each rule whose enemyRole has more than `above` share of the seen enemy strength multiplies role weights by boost^counter; armorWeight = how much an arm's damage after the seen enemy armour (Stats.applyArmor, per damage type) counts in its score (^ armorWeight × counter). `races` may override any key per race key. A9-F4b: the last phase (from 1500 s) allows the dearer tier 3 parts (Mk III torso / arms / legs).
